note: One video = productions/<slug>/. kind 'auto' stages are run by orbital.py; kind 'agent' stages are creative work Claude does with the named skill, then records with `orbital.py complete`. cost 'paid' needs an entry in approvals.json AND --confirm. There is deliberately no publish stage: upload is manual, by the owner.

stages.how: List 5+ candidate topics with 1-5 scores (tools/autopilot/topics.py score), keep only those with reliable evidence, write the decision.
Every spoken or on-screen claim with source URL, evidence type and status. Unverifiable claims are cut, not softened.
VO lines only in script.md; SCRIPT_LOCK.json holds the sha256 of the spoken text (orbital.py lock SLUG).
Counts billable characters exactly as yt-voice will bill them and checks chunk size, budget and cache.
One ElevenLabs pass, persistent chunk cache, never retried automatically (a failed request may still be billed).
Motion storyboard per scene, timeline v3 profile long, shots anchored to word timings; 12-15 s proof of the hardest sequence first.
Look at frames (contact sheet + the first 15 s + every graphic). Record what was looked at and what could NOT be verified. Level is VISUALLY_REVIEWED at most; only the owner grants USER_APPROVED.
Title/thumbnail pair, description checked line by line against the locked script, chapters, tags, copyright table, Studio upload steps. metadata.json must say published=false.
